_about: Loot pools (sea step 1e, diary/DESIGN_UNIQUES.md). A unique belongs to a pool by its own "pool" field in data/gun_uniques.json (no field = the world). One kill of a pool's source rolls core/loot_pool.gd roll(): `guns` rolled guns at the given luck and lowest tier, then each roll of `unique_chance` adds one named unique from the pool (a chase gun with chance `chase_share`, else a plain one; if that kind is empty the other kind). `world_pools` = the pools ("world" = uniques with no pool field: the 8 old ponies) whose uniques may also come out of an ordinary pony drop anywhere (core/gun_gen.gd); every other pool's uniques drop only from their own source. Item level = the caller's (the boss's level). borrow_chase (pool ids, FOR NOW, director 2026-11-20: add the chase guns to the made bosses for now): those pools' chase guns also drop from this pool until their own bosses are built (core/gun_db.gd pool_uniques); remove it then. All numbers are placeholders for the director.
